purpose: Independent P10 cross-slice linkage audit after Society, Law & Economic History evidence and Human View maturation.

coverage.relation_contract: Each cross-slice Relation has explicit frame_ref, no Relation participant, and at least two participants.
coverage.corpus_scope: Current corpus through P11 evidence-depth and cross-slice maturation, context/scope, Human View maturation and three substantive P10 cross-slice relations.

findings.basis: Five P11 relations were added only where a direct conceptual/measurement linkage is substantive: political economy ↔ taxation, labor economics ↔ social policy, and migration ↔ labor economics.
The added relations use the existing cross-slice contract: explicit frame_ref, no Relation participant, and two claim participants. No duplicate relation was introduced.
The added relations do not assert causal direction; they expose bounded conceptual or measurement linkage and preserve the evidence epistemic boundary.

conclusion.next_step: Repeat independent linkage validation during P10 final re-audit before CLEAN.

epistemic_boundary: Relations, conformance and provenance do not establish truth and do not replace independent evidence.
